title: Dick Johnson DJ
bio:
Dick Johnson DJ

*Monthly*

Dick Johnson a queer dj and producer from El Paso/Juarez. He is the creator of the collective Unruly (@unrulynolimits). Dicks dj sets are all about attention to detail a sound that grabs you and doesn’t let go. From sounds of disco to techno and literal chaos in between. Dick has been impacting the local scene in his home town of El Paso for quite some time. Now venturing as a producer as well he has a lot more to offer stay tuned!
